name: InitRemoteCalls
evidence: once (g_remoteCallsReady), sets up the remote call state g_remoteCallState with its three pools of 0x40-byte packets and installs the handlers of the commands 0x80000008 to 0x8000000C (InitIopCommandChannels, LoadIopModules and the IOP clients call it)

name: ShutDownRemoteCalls
evidence: shuts the command channel down (ShutDownCommandChannel) and clears g_remoteCallsReady (ResetIop calls it)

name: TakeRequestPacket
evidence: with interrupts disabled, marks the first free packet of the pool in use, gives it the next id and returns it, or 0 when none is free

name: FreeRequestPacket
evidence: clears a packet's id and its in-use bit

name: NextReplyPacket
evidence: returns the next packet of the reply ring, wrapping at its count

name: HandleRemoteCallReply
evidence: the handler of the IOP's replies: runs the client's callback for 0x8000000A, copies the found service for 0x80000009, signals the waiting client's semaphore and frees its packet

name: AnswerIopCall
evidence: answers an IOP call with a 0x8000000C packet from the reply ring through SendCommandFromInterrupt

name: FindRemoteService
evidence: walks the groups of services in g_remoteCallState and returns the entry whose first word is the key, or 0

name: AnswerServiceLookup
evidence: answers a 0x80000009 lookup with the entry FindRemoteService finds (or zeros) through SendCommandFromInterrupt

name: BindRemoteService
evidence: takes a request packet for the client, sends the bind command 0x80000009 for a service id and, unless asked not to wait, waits for the reply on a semaphore of its own (InitIopCommandChannels and every IOP client bind with it)

name: QueueServerRequest
evidence: appends an incoming request to its server's list and, when the server's thread is idle, wakes it with QueueThreadRequest

name: CallRemoteService
evidence: sends a bound client's request (command, send buffer, receive buffer, callback) and, unless asked not to, waits for the reply (SendIopCommandAndWait, the sound bank loads and every IOP client call it)

name: IsRemoteCallPending
evidence: returns 1 while the client's packet still has its id and its in-use bit (IsIopReplyReady and the sound bank loads poll it)
